description.value: The Denman Island Museum & Archives preserves the layered history of Denman Island in the Salish Sea, with collections and archives spanning First Nations heritage, early settler families, logging, farming, and decades of island social movements. Located right in the village as an annex of the Denman Activity Centre, it holds extensive archival fonds from local organizations, individuals, and community publications. A touring cyclist exploring Denman Island would find it a compact window into the island's distinctive cultural identity.

The museum is an annex of the Denman Activity Centre, which has a lounge and kitchen, but those facilities are not attributed to the museum itself.
